annotations.title: Concordium agent badge and vet402 verdict

description: Look up one Concordium CIS-8004 agent on Concordium testnet. Read-only. It does not pay and signs nothing. Pass agent: the agent token id, such as 1350, or the Concordium account that owns it. The answer holds badge_status from the agent registry, verdict (go, no or unproven) from the payments vet402 made to the agent, trust_summary in one line, and row_url for the transaction behind the verdict. go means what vet402 paid for arrived. no means payments did not arrive. unproven means vet402 has no counted payment for the agent, and an agent vet402 does not know comes back as unproven. The check is read from vet402-concordium.fly.dev, and the request carries the agent and the caller name vet402.com-mcp. It changes no data, needs no API key and has no charge. Up to 30 calls per minute per IP.
